It defines AC-001 (sessions expire after 30 minutes of inactivity) and AC-002 (users are signed out when the browser closes) and has no Retired Acceptance Identifiers or Previous Cycles section, so the next unused identifier is AC-003.

The scope was persisted but not yet handed off: WorkflowState is SCOPING after a FORWARD handoff from AUDITING, Architecture and Development are NONE, and recovery and outstanding obligations are inactive.
The scope's Goal, Constraints, Non-goals, and Assumptions do not depend on the browser-close condition; only AC-002 is replaced by the user's request.
The existing code keeps sessions for a fixed 12 hours from sign-in and sets a 12-hour sid cookie; no code change belongs to this run.
